definitions.floor_class: quiet (every |δ_area| ≤ noise.quiet_max_abs), offset (median |δ| above that and MAD ≈ 0: every perturbation shifted together), spread otherwise; stored next to the floor. A retained gain on an offset design is flagged
definitions.rule_A: t_D = max(2.0 × σ_robust, the design's own max |δ| incl. P0, pooled q90); designs without a measured floor carry the pooled minimum (floor_source = pooled)

pooled_quantiles_E4_area.note: design-weighted: each design's records weighted 1 / n_design (reports/data/phase2_noise_floor.json pooled_weighting = design); the frozen pooled minimum is the design-weighted q90 of the phase4 snapshot

a.largest_effect_phase2: mc_rf +18.7 % area and +64 % power from the re-print P0 (reports/phase2.md §6 G1)

b.diagnosed_count_note: the map counts 255 diagnosed objects (verdict proven or proven_sim_only, label not duplicate, E4 record present); the strictly proven set has 254 — the object that differs is [('c50bcff7d1f3960', 'rtlrewriter_fsm_small_case__example3', 'llm', 'c2', 'harmful')] (proven by simulation only, class c2, harmful at E4); 255 of the 255 carry a record at every rung E1–E4

c.phase4_md: 28 plain compile, 14 single flag (designware 14, gate_clock 4, retime 4, some by several), 32 full-effort only (reports/phase4.md §9 / §11)
c.reconciliation: in the data every object reproduced by a single flag is also converged under a plain compile (the 14 are a subset of the 28), so the exclusive split is 28 plain compile / 0 single-flag-only / 46 compile_ultra only; phase4.md's 32 assumed the 14 outside the 28 (28 + 14 + 32 = 74) and is a double count

permanence.definition: an object inside the band at a lower rung and above it at a higher one (area gain against the rung's t_D), over objects with a record at every rung E1–E4

class_a.note: 47 of 75 = class-(a) objects with an E4 record; a denominator of 73 counts only those with a record at every rung E1–E4 (the map's non-monotone denominator)

rtllm_d.source: reports/data/phase4_exp1.json contrast_phase3.d_by_design (run-time M3 verdicts of the Phase 3 calibration candidates; reports/phase4.md §8)

phase4_md.predictor_\u00a711: 0.717 with the class features and 0.733 without (reports/phase4.md §11)

e.which_applies: reports/data/phase4_exp1.json (the file the map is built from) holds AUROC 0.7103 with the class features and 0.7334 without; §6 of phase4.md quotes 0.710 / 0.733 from it; the 0.717 of §11 is not in the data file — the version consistent with the map is 0.733 / 0.710

released_proven_pairs.setting: data/sources/RTL-OPT/Results/RTL-OPT_DC: `compile` (not compile_ultra) at CLOCK_PERIOD 0.1 ns with set_max_delay from all inputs to all outputs, set_transform_for_retiming dont_retime, register merging / sequential area recovery / clock gating through hierarchy off, ungroup -all -flatten, DC T-2022.03-SP2, the authors' own Nangate45 typical.db (their released run_dc.tcl and command.log)

f.mux_dead: rtlopt_mux_dead's reference does not link under DC (LINK-3): the 'missing 1' of every setting; the released reports carry it (their DC T-2022.03 links it)

icg_insertion.note: request (b) item 5 is not in this session's record; computed here as retained candidates with a power gain above 2 % whose E4 netlist carries more clock-gating cells than D's E4 netlist

sources.source: SELECT design_id, floor_source, floor_class, t_d, pooled_min FROM noise_floor WHERE floor_version='phase4' AND config='E4' AND metric='area' (one row per design; the table the Phase 5 experiments use)
SELECT metric, MAX(pooled_min) FROM noise_floor WHERE floor_version='phase4' AND config='E4' GROUP BY metric (the same value on every design row of the configuration and metric)

SELECT e.design_id, e.config, e.pert_id, p.ptype, e.area_um2, e.cells, e.wns_ns, e.power_saif_mw, e.clock_ns FROM evaluations e JOIN perturbations p ON p.pert_id=e.pert_id WHERE e.status='ok' AND e.config IN ('E1','E2','E3','E4') AND e.design_id IN (frozen-table designs); baseline = is_baseline=1, pert_id IS NULL, cand_id IS NULL, same config and clock

src.noise.stats.proven_by_design + pick_records(conn, design, config, proven, phi_main, eps) for every frozen-table design: the baseline and the latest E4 record of each SEQ-proven perturbation at Φ_main (the records the floor rows were computed from); pooled quantiles by stats.pooled_quantile (design-weighted: every design's records weighted 1 / n_design; record-weighted for comparison)

scripts/phase2_noise.py cmd_collect: S.pooled_minimum over the set designs (designs.split IN ('dev','held')), SEQ-proven perturbations at Φ_main, quantile noise.pooled_quantile = 0.90, weighting noise.pooled_weighting = design; the frozen table then applies the minima to every design without a measured floor

reports/data/phase4_exp1.json objects[] (proven, label not duplicate, E4 gains present; n = 255) with per-level thresholds from src.analysis.objects.thresholds(conn, design, level, 'phase4'); survival modes: rule_a_any (some metric above t, the label retained or trade-off), area_only (the §2 map cell: area gain above t_area), mat_area (area gain > 1 %), mat_any (some metric above materiality)

reports/data/phase4_diagnoser_sample.json reproduction.rows (74 absorbed objects: D compiled with one flag alone — E1d designware, E2g gate_clock, E3 retime — or with a plain compile E1, against the object's plain-compile netlist C@E1; spec 04 §B.5) and phase4_exp1.json objects (label, rung, class); permanence = src.analysis.map.non_monotone over E1–E4 (reports/phase4.md §3)

reports/data/phase4_exp1.json objects (role b0, label retained or trade-off; the object with the largest E4 area gain of the design), gains per level; per-level rule-A verdict from the gains and the level's thresholds (retained: some metric above t and none below; trade-off: some above and some below; noise: all within; harmful: some below, none above); E1d / E2g carry no measured floor: verdict under the materiality thresholds there

src.analysis.map.misclassification_rates on the 255 objects — rule R forbids classes a / b and allows c1 / c2 / d; retained = label retained or trade-off; absorbed = absorbed, absorbed_identical, noise or duplicate — on (i) the class of phase4_exp1.json (the map's class_final at generation) and (ii) candidates.class_final as stored now; predictor AUROC from phase4_exp1.json predictor (leave-one-design-out logistic model, n = 255, 129 retained)

data/sources/RTL-OPT/Results/RTL-OPT_DC/<pair>/report/area.rpt and <pair>_ref/report/area.rpt, 'Total cell area' (the authors' released DC runs: plain compile at 0.1 ns, their Nangate45 typical.db); reports/data/phase4_rtlopt_setting.json rows (authors_released, E1_authors, E2_1ns per proven pair); reports/data/phase4_exp1.json literature

scripts/report_c1.scan_phase5 (every non-superseded Phase 5 candidate; rule A at E4 via src.analysis.phase5.uniform_diagnosis; duplicates collapsed: label duplicate never counted); evaluated = proven with an E4 record

candidates.label of the B0 arm (improved = any positive Y-caliber component); per metric: the candidate's Y record (evaluations config Y, same clock as the design's Y baseline) against the Y baseline — area gain (base − cand) / base, delay gain (cand WNS − base WNS) / clock — crossed with the rule-A E4 gains of the same candidate against the design's frozen t_D per metric

noise_floor (frozen phase4, E4 area row: floor_source / floor_class per design) joined with the Phase 5 scan; ICG insertion: log_summary_json.icg_count of the candidate's E4 record against the design's E4 baseline record; proof coverage: candidates with a verdict per design
